{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module CircuitBreaker where

import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Concurrent (threadDelay, forkIO)
import Control.Monad (when, void, forever)
import qualified Control.Exception
import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.Time.Clock.POSIX
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.List (genericLength)
import Data.Maybe (isJust)
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as BS
import Crypto.BCrypt
  ( hashPasswordUsingPolicy
  , slowerBcryptHashingPolicy
  , validatePassword
  )
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

data CircuitState = Closed | Open | HalfOpen deriving (Show, Eq)

data CircuitBreaker = CircuitBreaker
  { cbState       :: MVar CircuitState
  , cbFailCount   :: IORef Int
  , cbThreshold   :: Int
  , cbResetTime   :: NominalDiffTime
  , cbLastFailure :: IORef UTCTime
  , cbMetrics     :: MVar MetricsStore
  }

data MetricsStore = MetricsStore
  { msRequestCount :: !Int
  , msFailureCount :: !Int
  , msStateChanges :: ![StateChange]
  , msAuthTokens   :: Map.Map String TokenEntry
  }

data TokenEntry = TokenEntry
  { teHashedToken :: String  -- bcrypt hash of token
  , teCreatedAt   :: UTCTime
  } deriving (Show)

data StateChange = StateChange
  { scFrom      :: CircuitState
  , scTo        :: CircuitState
  , scTimestamp :: UTCTime
  , scReason    :: String
  } deriving (Show)

newCircuitBreaker :: Int -> NominalDiffTime -> IO CircuitBreaker
newCircuitBreaker threshold resetTime = do
  state <- newMVar Closed
  failCount <- newIORef 0
  now <- getCurrentTime
  lastFail <- newIORef now
  metrics <- newMVar $ MetricsStore 0 0 [] Map.empty
  return $ CircuitBreaker state failCount threshold resetTime lastFail metrics

-- | Register a monitoring token for a service (stores hashed)
registerMonitorToken :: CircuitBreaker -> String -> String -> IO ()
registerMonitorToken cb service token = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  hashed <- bcryptHash token  -- one-way, salted hash
  modifyMVar_ (cbMetrics cb) $ \ms ->
    return $ ms { msAuthTokens = Map.insert service (TokenEntry hashed now) (msAuthTokens ms) }

-- | Atomic authorization + state transition (no TOCTOU)
-- Authorization and state change happen under the SAME lock
requestStateTransition :: CircuitBreaker -> String -> String -> CircuitState -> IO Bool
requestStateTransition cb service token targetState = do
  modifyMVar (cbMetrics cb) $ \ms -> do
    let mEntry = Map.lookup service (msAuthTokens ms)
    case mEntry of
      Nothing -> return (ms, False)
      Just entry -> do
        if bcryptVerify token (teHashedToken entry)
          then do
            oldState <- takeMVar (cbState cb)
            now <- getCurrentTime
            let change = StateChange oldState targetState now ("authorized by " ++ service)
            let ms' = ms { msStateChanges = change : msStateChanges ms }
            putMVar (cbState cb) targetState
            return (ms', True)
          else return (ms, False)

-- | Record a failure and potentially trip the circuit
recordFailure :: CircuitBreaker -> IO CircuitState
recordFailure cb = do
  count <- atomicModifyIORef' (cbFailCount cb) (\c -> (c + 1, c + 1))
  now <- getCurrentTime
  writeIORef (cbLastFailure cb) now
  modifyMVar (cbState cb) $ \currentState -> do
    if count >= cbThreshold cb && currentState == Closed
      then do
        modifyMVar_ (cbMetrics cb) $ \ms ->
          return $ ms { msFailureCount = msFailureCount ms + 1
                      , msStateChanges = StateChange Closed Open now "threshold exceeded" : msStateChanges ms
                      }
        return (Open, Open)
      else return (currentState, currentState)

-- | Execute an action through the circuit breaker
execute :: CircuitBreaker -> IO a -> IO (Either String a)
execute cb action = do
  state <- readMVar (cbState cb)
  case state of
    Open -> do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      lastFail <- readIORef (cbLastFailure cb)
      if diffUTCTime now lastFail > cbResetTime cb
        then do
          modifyMVar_ (cbState cb) $ \_ -> return HalfOpen
          tryAction cb action
        else return $ Left "Circuit is open"
    Closed -> tryAction cb action
    HalfOpen -> tryAction cb action

tryAction :: CircuitBreaker -> IO a -> IO (Either String a)
tryAction cb action = do
  result <- (Right <$> action) `catch` (\e -> return $ Left (show (e :: IOError)))
  case result of
    Left err -> do
      void $ recordFailure cb
      return $ Left err
    Right val -> do
      atomicWriteIORef (cbFailCount cb) 0
      modifyMVar_ (cbState cb) $ \_ -> return Closed
      return $ Right val
  where
    catch :: IO a -> (IOError -> IO a) -> IO a
    catch = Control.Exception.catch

-- | Monitoring endpoint - only exposes aggregate metrics, no secrets
dumpMetrics :: CircuitBreaker -> IO String
dumpMetrics cb = do
  metrics <- readMVar (cbMetrics cb)
  let serviceCount = Map.size (msAuthTokens metrics)
  return $ "Metrics: requests=" ++ show (msRequestCount metrics)
        ++ " failures=" ++ show (msFailureCount metrics)
        ++ " registered_services=" ++ show serviceCount
        ++ " state_changes=" ++ show (length (msStateChanges metrics))

-- Real bcrypt (salted, adaptive cost) via the crypto-bcrypt package.
-- Produces a properly salted one-way hash; verification uses the stored salt.
bcryptHash :: String -> IO String
bcryptHash input = do
  mHashed <- hashPasswordUsingPolicy slowerBcryptHashingPolicy (BS.pack input)
  case mHashed of
    Just h  -> return (BS.unpack h)
    Nothing -> Control.Exception.throwIO (userError "bcrypt hashing failed")

bcryptVerify :: String -> String -> Bool
bcryptVerify input hashed =
  validatePassword (BS.pack hashed) (BS.pack input)
